name: Chests of Cai Shen

features.name: Three coloured chests
features.description: Coins fill chests that grow and raise bonus odds.

features.name: Three Hold & Spin variants
features.description: Each chest has its own bonus, which can combine.

features.name: Coin upgrades
features.description: The green chest upgrades coin values.

review:
A Chinese luck 5x3 with green, red and purple coins. Each coin goes into its matching chest above the reels, which grows and raises the chance of its bonus.

Land six coins of one colour to trigger that chest's Hold & Spin – each chest has its own version (the green one can upgrade coin values, for example), and they can combine. Three chests means lots of variety. Up to 5,000x, 96.57% RTP.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
